name: Bizkit POS Connector for WooCommerce
author: Peter Kimani Mungai

sections.description:
Bizkit POS Connector for WooCommerce integrates your WooCommerce store with Bizkit POS, enabling businesses to manage both online and in-store sales from a single platform.
The plugin automatically synchronizes product information, inventory levels, and orders between WooCommerce and Bizkit, reducing manual work and helping keep your sales channels in sync.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Bizkit cloud service to synchronize products, inventory, orders and other business data between WooCommerce and Bizkit POS.

It sends data to the Bizkit service only after the store owner connects their Bizkit account and enables synchronization.

The plugin may send the following information:
* Store identifier
* Authentication token
* Product information
* Inventory levels
* Order information
* Customer information (only when customer synchronization is enabled)

The data is transmitted only when the store owner connects the plugin to a Bizkit account and initiates synchronization, or when automatic synchronization is triggered through webhooks or scheduled background tasks.
Bizkit service:
https://bizkit.tech

Privacy Policy:
https://bizkit.tech/privacy-policy

Terms of Service:
https://portal.bizkit.tech/terms-and-conditions/
